Resolves #21621

Related: #21346 · #21140 · #21613

Adds `examples/scheduler/liveUpdates`, an airport gate operations scheduler (`14` gates across Piers A–C and `60` flights over `06:00–12:00 UTC`) backed by `Neo.data.Store` (`GateStore`, `FlightStore`) and `Neo.data.Model` (`GateModel`, `FlightModel`). A deterministic Mulberry32 generator (`?seed=19257`, `1s` cadence, no network requests) slips flights, lands new arrivals into free turnaround slots, and frees gates while advancing changed-flight highlights from at-rest (`.is-feed-fresh`) to `.is-feed-fading` via `setSilent` before each primary store mutation, preserving horizontal/vertical scroll and skipping any bar currently held in `eventDragZone`.

**Catalog record for #21613:**
- `id`: `'scheduler-live-updates'`
- `name`: `'A plan that updates itself'`
- `feature`: `'Flights arrive, slip and leave on a simulated feed while you scroll and drag'`
- `lookFor`: `'Watch a delayed flight slide along its gate. Scroll, or drag a flight, while the feed runs. Then pause it.'`
- `cover`: The gates with one flight marked as just changed (`liveupdates-1440x900-marks-dark.jpg`).

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline + guards ran`

Evidence: L3 (Playwright E2E `LiveUpdates.spec.mjs` in `e2e-engine` CI covering 120-tick concurrent dual-viewport feed soak at `1440 × 900` & `390 × 844`, 5-theme matrix, scroll + mid-drag survival, and VDOM delta audit, plus Outside-CI literal `120.5s` `1s`-cadence soak and two swapped-order zero-context cold reads) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-7). Residual: none for #21621; batch catalog publication lives in #21613.

## Deltas from ticket

- Scoped `--neo-timeline-gridline-step` (`270px` at `4.5 px/min` desktop, `180px` at `3.0 px/min` compact) directly onto `.gate-scheduler .neo-timeline-track` so `.neo-grid-view`'s `:where(.neo-theme-*)` variable re-declaration does not reset hourly gridlines to `120px` (out-of-scope theme-level root cause noted by `@neo-opus-ada` in `MESSAGE:691700ff`, promoted to `#21735`), pinned by a computed-style E2E assertion across all five themes.
- Exposed optional `?seed=` and `?interval=` query overrides (`DEFAULT_SEED = 19257`, `DEFAULT_TICK_MS = 1000`) so `LiveUpdates.spec.mjs` drives `120` deterministic feed mutations in `~11s` inside `.github/workflows/test.yml`'s `6m` `e2e-engine` shard budget while `NEO_LIVE_UPDATES_SOAK=1` runs the literal `120.5s` `1s`-cadence wall-clock soak.

Frame critique: Whole-surface verdict is `BETTER` vs `scheduler/basic` on both desktop (`1440 × 900`: `9.1 / 10` & `8.7 / 10` vs `6.2 / 10` & `6.0 / 10`) and mobile (`390 × 844`: `8.5 / 10` & `8.2 / 10` vs `4.2 / 10` & `4.0 / 10`). Self-inspection and two blind cold reads surfaced four actionable visual nits, all resolved in the shipped frames: (1) scoped `--neo-timeline-gridline-step` onto `.neo-timeline-track` so vertical gridlines align pixel-for-pixel with `06:00`–`12:00` headers at both `270px` and `180px`; (2) replaced font-dependent Unicode `●` / `◌` legend glyphs with CSS `::before` indicator dots matching the solid/dashed card borders; (3) reset `.gate-toolbar > *` margins and flowed `.gate-feed-ticker` inline under `@media (max-width: 767px)` so all four header controls fit on a single row at `390 × 844` without orphan wrapping; and (4) harmonized `.is-paused .gate-sim-badge` border/fill/text to the warm amber paused palette so the paused dot never clashes against an emerald border. Retained intentional invariants: `Pause` keeps its stable WAI-ARIA `aria-pressed` toggle label (as specified in #21621 rather than mutating label + `aria-pressed` simultaneously, which inverts screen-reader announcements), `flex-wrap: wrap` remains enabled as a graceful fallback below `375px`, light-theme axis header text and bar resize grips stay owned by shared `Neo.timeline.TimeAxisHeader` / `Neo.timeline.Column` theme tokens, and `Gate C2` / `Gate C1` peek at the bottom scroll fold as natural vertical scroll cues for the 14-gate table.

This is a strong example: the feed goes through `record.set()`, `store.add()` and `store.remove()` only, so the Column's own store listeners carry every update; the dragged record is skipped through the drag zone's public `eventRecord`; the timer is owned by the Viewport and cleared on pause and destroy; and the marks are a record field rendered by `barRenderer`, with the motion on the engine's tokens (reduced motion included).
